arguments.command:
git add action.yml scripts src && git commit -q -m "feat: stop installing git hooks in the target repository

The action no longer installs commit-msg or prepare-commit-msg hooks in
the checkout before pi starts. Commit conventions belong to the target
repository: its own hooks, CI checks, and AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md.

Remove scripts/install-agent-hooks.js and its test, keep the tests of
this repository's own prepare-commit-msg hook in their own file, and
add tests that action.yml installs no hooks and that a run leaves the
checkout's hooks directory (and core.hooksPath) untouched.

Refs #38" && git add -A docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md && git commit -q -m "docs: say that pi follows the repository's own commit conventions

Remove the git hooks step and the 'Git hooks for the agent' section,
and add a 'Commit conventions' section: pi-action installs no hooks,
and repositories that want a commit format enforce it themselves.

Refs #38" && git status --short && git log --oneline -3
